name: Employee Resignation Notice
description: Written, dated, signed resignation letter specifying the effective date; professional employees give at least 60 days' notice, non-certificated administrative and support employees at least two weeks.
recipient: Immediate supervisor and Director of Human Resources
deadline: At least 60 days (professional) or 2 weeks (non-certificated) before effective date
quote: Professional employees shall submit a resignation letter at least sixty (60) days prior to the resignation's effective date in accordance with law and Board Policy.
